There is a player-created asset for this now, linked below, but it requires specialized shaders on your avatar as far as I can tell. It would be nice if this was an officially supported feature.

https://booth.pm/en/items/4794980

details:
Since Phys Bones is going to be a much more optimised way of having secondary motion compared to Dynamic Bones, I'd love to see a feature for adding wind to worlds that cause player Phys Bones to blow around.
As an example, imagine a world where there's some big dramatic portal opening in front of a group of players and when it opens have wind blowing through affecting the dynamics of the players.
title: World Wind for Phys Bones
